title.narrative: Ingwavuma Orphan Care & Home Based Care

description.narrative: This bridging (1-year) grant will allow time & resources for a thorough external evaluation of the 5-year Comic Relief project (ends Nov2011) and the work as a whole, and inform a subsequent 3-year bid (in Feb 2012) to Comic Relief, while providing funding for key services to continue during 2011. The AIDS epidemic has infected 29% of the KwaZuluNatal population and has affected the whole population. As young adults die, the old are left to care for thousands of orphans without a breadwinner in the house. However, access to antiretroviral treatment means that many people living with HIV are becoming healthier again and are looking for ways to support their families. Jobs are scarce with an unemployment rate over 80% so this presents a challenge. Isibani Sethemba is a grass roots organisation which brings hope to thousands by providing home based care to the sick, empowering people with HIV to run support groups, improving relationships between men and women through couples counselling, running a youth centred mobile HIV testing unit and helping the community to care for its orphans. This project aims to further increase the capacity of people with HIV to respond to the epidemic.
